absolute bottom-0 left-0 translate-y-full"><h3 class="text-[26px] leading-120 tracking-0 font-sans-condensed font-light sm:text-[38px] sm:leading-110 sm:-tracking-1 sm:font-sans-condensed class="text-[26px] leading-120 tracking-0 font-sans-condensed font-light sm:text-[38px] sm:leading-110 sm:-tracking-1 sm:font-sans-condensed sm:font-light sm:normal-case sm:static sm:top-0 text-grey">Fitbit Ace LTE</h3></div><div class="duration-[133ms] ease-[cubic-bezier(0.75,0,0.85,1)] absolute bottom-0 left-0 translate-y-full"><h3 class="text-[26px] leading-120 tracking-0 font-sans-condensed font-light sm:text-[38px] sm:leading-110 sm:-tracking-1 sm:font-sans-condensed sm:font-light sm:normal-case sm:static sm:top-0 text-grey">Tripadvisor</h3></div></div></div><div class="mt-auto hidden flex-col gap-y-12 md:flex"><div data-ref-featured-project-description="true" class="pointer-events-auto grid grid-cols-6 gap-x-2 md:opacity-0"><div class="relative col-span-4"><div class="transition-opacity duration-[167ms] ease-linear relative opacity-100 delay-[333ms]"><p class="text-[15px] leading-125 tracking-0 font-sans font-[350] sm:text-4 sm:leading-125 sm:tracking-0 sm:font-sans sm:font-[350] sm:normal-case sm:static sm:top-0 text-grey">There are parts of Instagram that will never change. It will always remain a platform for creators to experiment, find, and share their voice.
But the Instagram of today has pushed far beyond what it once was. With that growth comes the opportunity to build for the future—and double down on what matters most. The Instagram Design Team came to us to do just that: to reimagine a globally recognized wordmark, bring it in line with an evolving brand system, and ensure it stands the test of time.</p></div><div class="transition-opacity duration-[167ms] ease-linear absolute bottom-0 left-0 opacity-0 delay-[0ms]"><p class="text-[15px] leading-125 tracking-0 font-sans font-[350] sm:text-4 sm:leading-125 sm:tracking-0 sm:font-sans sm:font-[350] sm:normal-case sm:static sm:top-0 text-grey">An 18-month project across 15 markets and more than 50 sub-brands. With Amazon XCM we modernized the brand’s core assets, a warmer smile, a flexible new typeface and a unified palette, so the brand could move at Amazon speed with clarity and consistency, and put design at the heart and the forefront of the company.

Our focus was on restoring clarity and confidence. A shared system linking every sub-brand back to the parent. One system, strong enough to carry across 50+ lines of business, flexible enough to stretch across global markets, audiences and teams. The goal was to make Amazon feel unified again, and recapture the magic of finding exactly what you need, exactly when you need it.</p></div><div class="transition-opacity duration-[167ms] ease-linear absolute bottom-0 left-0 opacity-0 delay-[0ms]"><p class="text-[15px] leading-125 tracking-0 font-sans font-[350] sm:text-4 sm:leading-125 sm:tracking-0 sm:font-sans sm:font-[350] sm:normal-case sm:static sm:top-0 text-grey">Microsoft’s latest flagship is Copilot+PC, a new class of computers powered by Copilot. Pushing the technology to new heights, they asked us to create a brand identity that signals a new era in personal computing – redefining AI by showing its practical power and everyday impact.</p></div><div class="transition-opacity duration-[167ms] ease-linear absolute bottom-0 left-0 opacity-0 delay-[0ms]"><p class="text-[15px] leading-125 tracking-0 font-sans font-[350] sm:text-4 sm:leading-125 sm:tracking-0 sm:font-sans sm:font-[350] sm:normal-case sm:static sm:top-0 text-grey">Google’s Fitbit Ace LTE set out to create the first connected smartwatch designed to get kids moving—shifting them away from sedentary gaming and into physical play. The challenge was twofold: compete with the excitement of traditional gaming, while reassuring parents about screen time and health. The brand had to speak to kids’ desire for fun and parents’ need for confidence in a product that could make activity both engaging and beneficial.</p></div><div class="transition-opacity duration-[167ms] ease-linear absolute bottom-0 left-0 opacity-0 delay-[0ms]"><p class="text-[15px] leading-125 tracking-0 font-sans font-[350] sm:text-4 sm:leading-125 sm:tracking-0 sm:font-sans sm:font-[350] sm:normal-case sm:static sm:top-0 text-grey">For 25 years, Tripadvisor has been the world’s travel companion, with real reviews, real advice, straight from real people. But in a race to compete with booking engines and comparison sites on price and capacity, the brand risked losing its edge. We set out to refocus on what makes Tripadvisor unique: its community of real travelers, and their real reviews.</p></div></div></div><div data-ref-featured-project-footer="true" Brand: Why you still need a website in the age of AI\",\"slug\":\"off-brand-why-you-still-need-a-website-in-the-age-of-ai\",\"href\":\"/latest/off-brand-why-you-still-need-a-website-in-the-age-of-ai\",\"date\":\"Thu 23 Oct, 2025\",\"dateShort\":\"Thu logo.\",\"height\":512,\"url\":\"https://cdn.sanity.io/images/sbsn7wuy/production/b8ab1e61cb44fabfd0c74bfc973655ebbbc95eea-512x512.png\",\"width\":512,\"orientation\":\"square\"},\"link\":\"https://offbrandkoto.substack.com/p/the-single-source-of-truth-why-you\",\"buttonText\":\"\"},\"previewText\":\"AI is reshaping discovery, but your website still builds trust. It’s not a relic; it’s the only part of the internet you truly own, shaping how people see, believe, connect, and buy from you.\",\"media\":{\"_type\":\"video\",\"video\":\"https://vimeo.com/1133546693/2747768ee8\",\"disableAutoplay\":false},\"mediaAspectRatio\":\"4:3\",\"tag\":{\"name\":\"Newsletters\",\"slug\":\"newsletters\"},\"introduction\":\"AI is reshaping discovery, but your website still builds trust. It’s not a relic; it’s the only part of the internet you truly own, shaping how people see, believe, connect, and buy from you.\",\"image\":{\"alt\":\"\",\"height\":0,\"url\":\"\",\"width\":0,\"orientation\":\"landscape\"},\"body\":[{\"_key\":\"3df453ba5c44\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"90f0b78d3336\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"In a world where discovery happens on social and decision-making is filtered through AI, it’s easy to think websites have lost their power. They haven’t. OFF Brand argues the opposite: your website is still your most valuable digital asset. The only space you truly own. The place where attention turns into trust, and trust turns into action. \"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"be4f91423152\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"90f0b78d3336\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"This issue traces how websites evolved from static brochures to content hubs, then got sidelined by social feeds, and why they’re now being recentered. Social platforms spark awareness, but your website still drives consideration, conversion, and credibility. It’s where your brand story meets business results.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"33ad9f3d2068\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"90f0b78d3336\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"We break down how strong sites build equity instead of renting it, and how they’ve become a brand’s single source of truth for both people and AI. Expect sharp, practical insight on what makes a modern website work: structured data that AI can read, consistent UX, clear storytelling, and the authority signals that earn trust. \"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"4cf3688b19dd\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"90f0b78d3336\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"The takeaway? The smartest brands aren’t abandoning the web. They’re reclaiming it. Because in the age of AI, winning means knowing when to borrow reach and when to own meaning.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}],\"metadata\":{\"title\":\"OFF Brand: Why you still need a website in the age of AI\",\"displayTitle\":\"OFF Brand: Why you still need a website in the age of AI | undefined\"}},{\"_key\":\"1c499df9-96d9-4cba-b196-be20841fb4c7\",\"title\":\"\\\"Some UK brands are tired,\\\" Koto's James Greenfield on branding today\",\"slug\":\"some-uk-brands-are-tired-koto-s-james-greenfield-on-branding-today\",\"href\":\"/latest/some-uk-brands-are-tired-koto-s-james-greenfield-on-branding-today\",\"date\":\"Sat 20 Sep, 2025\",\"dateShort\":\"Sat 20 Sep\",\"source\":{\"name\":\"Creative Bloq\",\"logo\":{\"alt\":\"Creative Bloq logo.\",\"height\":640,\"url\":\"https://cdn.sanity.io/images/sbsn7wuy/production/5171d7f541686fc82b5bfda5cf01ac10f59cf449-640x640.png\",\"width\":640,\"orientation\":\"square\"},\"link\":\"https://www.creativebloq.com/design/branding/kotos-james-greenfield-on-the-state-of-branding-today\",\"buttonText\":\"\"},\"previewText\":\"Who decides when a brand needs evolution or revolution? James Greenfield on Amazon’s refresh, tired UK brands, and why design discipline matters for work that is hard to copy or ignore.\",\"media\":{\"_type\":\"image\",\"image\":{\"alt\":\"James Greenfield, Koto CEO giving a talk.\",\"height\":1620,\"url\":\"https://cdn.sanity.io/images/sbsn7wuy/production/35695cf064a5e0bd5276faf373b8f61ccae70539-2160x1620.jpg\",\"width\":2160,\"orientation\":\"landscape\"}},\"mediaAspectRatio\":\"4:3\",\"tag\":{\"name\":\"Press\",\"slug\":\"press\"},\"introduction\":\"Who decides when a brand needs evolution or revolution? James Greenfield on Amazon’s refresh, tired UK brands, and why design discipline matters for work that is hard to copy or ignore.\",\"image\":{\"alt\":\"\",\"height\":0,\"url\":\"\",\"width\":0,\"orientation\":\"landscape\"},\"body\":[{\"_key\":\"2c4262781f0c\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"27c98e34518e\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"In a candid conversation with Creative Bloq, Koto’s James Greenfield unpacks the state of branding today, drawing on recent work with Amazon and lessons from icons like Nike and Apple. His core argument is simple: design without discipline leaves brands stuck in the past, while strong creative signatures make them harder to copy and easier to love. \"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"4867a9580d26\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"27c98e34518e\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Greenfield points to legacy UK names such as O2, Sky, and Carphone Warehouse as examples of brands that have failed to evolve. Customers notice when identity is rooted in outdated references, and familiarity alone is no longer enough. By contrast, brands like Apple prove the compounding value of putting design at the centre of strategy, showing that consistency and clarity pay off long term. \"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"4d74688f27e0\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"27c98e34518e\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"He also reflects on Amazon’s refresh, highlighting how consumer relationships differ wildly across markets. For some, Amazon means Prime content; for others, it means pharmacy, retail, or logistics. Bridging those experiences requires storytelling that respects cultural context and builds trust step by step.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"ff35584a8012\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"27c98e34518e\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"The takeaway is clear: meaningful brands are disciplined, culturally aware, and not afraid to take risks that push them out of the middle ground. Read the full interview in Creative Bloq.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}],\"metadata\":{\"title\":\"\\\"Some UK brands are tired,\\\" Koto's James Greenfield on branding today\",\"displayTitle\":\"\\\"Some UK brands are tired,\\\" Koto's James Greenfield on branding today | undefined\",\"ogImage\":{\"alt\":\"James Greenfield, Koto CEO giving a talk.\",\"height\":1620,\"url\":\"https://cdn.sanity.io/images/sbsn7wuy/production/35695cf064a5e0bd5276faf373b8f61ccae70539-2160x1620.jpg\",\"width\":2160,\"orientation\":\"landscape\"},\"twitterImage\":\"$11:props:children:props:children:props:widgetNews:1:metadata:ogImage\",\"description\":\"James Greenfield on the triggers for brand evolution, Amazon’s identity refresh, and creating design work that stands out and lasts.\"}},{\"_key\":\"9a8b5c93-5a4c-44e3-b1aa-9e3b8d4300c7\",\"title\":\"OFF Brand: Branding longevity, the next health frontier\",\"slug\":\"off-brand-branding-longevity-the-next-health-frontier\",\"href\":\"/latest/off-brand-branding-longevity-the-next-health-frontier\",\"date\":\"Wed 10 Sep, 2025\",\"dateShort\":\"Wed 10 Sep\",\"source\":{\"name\":\"OFF Brand\",\"logo\":{\"alt\":\"OFF Brand logo.\",\"height\":512,\"url\":\"https://cdn.sanity.io/images/sbsn7wuy/production/b8ab1e61cb44fabfd0c74bfc973655ebbbc95eea-512x512.png\",\"width\":512,\"orientation\":\"square\"},\"link\":\"https://offbrandkoto.substack.com/p/branding-longevity-the-next-health\",\"buttonText\":\"\"},\"previewText\":\"Longevity has moved from labs to shelves, spas, and wrists. OFF Brand explores how health is becoming culture, and why trust, clarity, and aspiration are now core to branding this frontier.\",\"media\":{\"_type\":\"video\",\"video\":\"https://vimeo.com/1124254365/f00f31bd43\",\"disableAutoplay\":false},\"mediaAspectRatio\":\"4:3\",\"tag\":{\"name\":\"Newsletters\",\"slug\":\"newsletters\"},\"introduction\":\"Longevity has moved from labs to shelves, spas, and wrists. OFF Brand explores how health is becoming culture, and why trust, clarity, and aspiration are now core to branding this frontier.\",\"image\":{\"alt\":\"\",\"height\":0,\"url\":\"\",\"width\":0,\"orientation\":\"landscape\"},\"body\":[{\"_key\":\"bec55a3e99d8\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"46149244b61a\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Longevity is not a niche. It is a fast-forming ecosystem where science, culture, and commerce meet. This issue maps the terrain and gives you a plan to win. We show why longevity is a new status signal and how brands shape behavior across food, drink, wearables, clinics, and at home.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"ad5afba99a77\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"46149244b61a\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"The consumer shift is real: protein and plants feel premium, electrolytes go lifestyle, supplements become rituals, and strength training rewrites who fitness is for. The data layer is the new battleground. Wearables and diagnostics must turn numbers into coaching, protect privacy, and make personalisation simple.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"e50c5a7aa93a\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"46149244b61a\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"We name the traps, from clinical beige to cohort cliches, and we offer five positioning archetypes to cut through: Health OS, Performance Lab, Longevity Concierge, Femtech Stack, Preventative Insurer.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"d9606da41a9e\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"46149244b61a\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Some of our advice: Anchor claims in science and plain language. Design for progress, not perfection. Blend aspiration with access so more people can join and stay. Build journeys that shift customers from quick fixes to habits. Visually, trade sterile minimalism for identities that feel human, warm, and unmistakable. The result you are after is trust at every touchpoint.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"683dbe4c73b9\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"46149244b61a\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Want the full frameworks, pitfalls, and examples to brief your team this quarter? Read OFF Brand and take the playbook.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}],\"metadata\":{\"title\":\"OFF Brand: Branding longevity, the next health frontier\",\"displayTitle\":\"OFF Brand: Branding longevity, the next health frontier | undefined\"}}],\"studios\":[{\"_key\":\"fd31ce47-26ca-4784-8ffe-468a2c984b12\",\"name\":\"Los Angeles\",\"slug\":\"los-angeles\",\"code\":\"LA\",\"email\":\"la@koto.com\",\"phone\":\"+1 310 691 2120\",\"photo\":{\"alt\":\"Koto's Los Angeles studio.\",\"height\":1080,\"url\":\"https://cdn.sanity.io/images/sbsn7wuy/production/bb5d19c317d65e7748f987ce465cd96a8a19bed2-1920x1080.jpg\",\"width\":1920,\"orientation\":\"landscape\"},\"address\":\"3962 Ince Blvd.\\nCulver City, CA 90232\\nUnited States\",\"addressStreet\":\"3962 Ince Blvd.\",\"addressLocality\":\"Culver City\",\"addressRegion\":\"CA\",\"postalCode\":\"90232\",\"addressCountry\":\"United States\",\"locationDescription\":\"Our studio in LA.\",\"contacts\":[{\"_key\":\"b4e0d9127b59\",\"_id\":\"34fa9913-cfed-446a-b1e4-5552bf1d0a3f\",\"name\":\"Chris Letourneau\",\"role\":\"Managing Director\",\"email\":\"chris@koto.com\",\"image\":{\"alt\":\"Headshot of Chris Letourneau.\",\"height\":1296,\"url\":\"https://cdn.sanity.io/images/sbsn7wuy/production/be9314467c9ea12f319c2e5052a34ac242e7224c-2304x1296.jpg\",\"width\":2304,\"orientation\":\"landscape\"},\"studio\":\"$undefined\",\"bio\":\"Chrissy is Managing Director of our LA studio, overseeing client partnerships, creative delivery, and operational excellence. fifteen years, Instagram evolved from a place to share photos into one of the world’s most influential cultural platforms—a home for creators, communities, businesses, and everyday interactions. During that time, the way people create changed. The way people communicate changed. And Instagram changed to meet the expanding needs of its growing community.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"c1ff65e81c37\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"ddf91b5708dd\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"ceea9ee5df77\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"266a819cd831\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Yet one thing remained largely untouched: the wordmark.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"65b38025fd16\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"2bce57546bcf\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"b3dc55c85248\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"144e4958f087\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"As Instagram’s broader brand ecosystem evolved, a new tension emerged. The Instagram glyph became ubiquitous. While the wordmark, despite its immense equity, remained constrained.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"0ec5aeee22c9\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"584a7f01a446\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"3a061797284f\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"d6b9d43cc39b\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"The original wordmark had served the brand well. But it was now expected to function as a marquee global brand asset, working in concert with the wider brand system across marketing campaigns, product experiences, creator ecosystems, and cultural moments. All while scaling into new apps like Instants and Edits.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"061c8769bbec\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"63fd744fe029\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"ee3886e379c0\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"6e9c1ef7b813\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"The challenge was complex, but clear: create a wordmark capable of expressing what Instagram is today and will be in the future, while preserving the familiarity and equity built over more than a decade of global recognition.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}],\"featureDescription\":\"There are parts of Instagram that will never change. It will always remain a platform for creators to experiment, find, and share their voice.\\nBut the Instagram of today has pushed far beyond what it once was. With that growth comes the opportunity to build for the future—and double down on what matters most. The Instagram Design Team came to us to do just that: to reimagine a globally recognized wordmark, bring it in line with an evolving brand system, and ensure it stands the test of time.\"},{\"_key\":\"6f0fa077ef6e\",\"title\":\"Amazon \",\"subtitle\":\"Global brand transformation\",\"link\":\"/projects/amazon\",\"slug\":\"amazon\",\"year\":\"2025\",\"tag\":\"Marketplaces\",\"squareThumbnail\":{\"alt\":\"Amazon logo.\",\"height\":800,\"url\":\"https://cdn.sanity.io/images/sbsn7wuy/production/154df3aff191e7e7afde6b79ac3f8256409768ef-800x800.png\",\"width\":800,\"orientation\":\"square\"},\"portraitThumbnail\":{\"_type\":\"video\",\"video\":\"https://vimeo.com/1221211735/eae8b15133?fl=ip\u0026fe=ec\",\"disableAutoplay\":false},\"mediumThumbnail\":{\"_type\":\"video\",\"video\":\"https://vimeo.com/1079147867/5ca50829d7?fl=ip\u0026fe=ec\",\"disableAutoplay\":false},\"landscapeThumbnail\":{\"_type\":\"video\",\"video\":\"https://vimeo.com/1079147867/5ca50829d7?fl=ip\u0026fe=ec\",\"disableAutoplay\":false},\"hoverThumbnailPortrait\":\"$undefined\",\"hoverThumbnailMedium\":\"$undefined\",\"hoverThumbnailLandscape\":\"$undefined\",\"heroPortrait\":{\"_type\":\"video\",\"video\":\"https://vimeo.com/1079406632/7eb343c4ef?fl=ip\u0026fe=ec\",\"disableAutoplay\":false},\"heroLandscape\":{\"_type\":\"video\",\"video\":\"https://vimeo.com/1079147867/5ca50829d7?fl=ip\u0026fe=ec\",\"disableAutoplay\":false},\"filters\":[],\"introduction\":[{\"_key\":\"1d417f920db6\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"c757bb54626d\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"An 18-month project across 15 markets and more than 50 sub-brands. With Amazon XCM we modernized the brand’s core assets, a warmer smile, a flexible new typeface and a unified palette, so the brand could move at Amazon speed with clarity and consistency, and put design at the heart and the forefront of the company.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"f5f145944221\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"c011cf277213\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"180b382af810\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"16a8eb2529fe\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Our focus was on restoring clarity and confidence. A shared system linking every sub-brand back to the parent. One system, strong enough to carry across 50+ lines of business, flexible enough to stretch across global markets, audiences and teams. The goal was to make Amazon feel unified again, and recapture the magic of finding exactly what you need, exactly when you need it.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}],\"featureDescription\":\"An 18-month project across 15 markets and more than 50 sub-brands. With Amazon XCM we modernized the brand’s core assets, a warmer smile, a flexible new typeface and a unified palette, so the brand could move at Amazon speed with clarity and consistency, and put design at the heart and the forefront of the company.\\n\\nOur focus was on restoring clarity and confidence. A shared system linking every sub-brand back to the parent. One system, strong enough to carry across 50+ lines of business, flexible enough to stretch across global markets, audiences and teams. Koto’s Damian Borchok\",\"slug\":\"apac-is-rewriting-global-branding\",\"href\":\"/latest/apac-is-rewriting-global-branding\",\"date\":\"Thu 19 Nov, 2026\",\"dateShort\":\"Thu 19 future of global branding isn’t being shaped in London or New York. In this sharp take, Koto’s APAC MD Damian Borchok breaks down why the real creative edge now sits in Asia and what that means for brand leaders today. If you’re still applying Western playbooks, you’re already behind.\",\"media\":{\"_type\":\"image\",\"image\":{\"alt\":\"\",\"height\":436,\"url\":\"https://cdn.sanity.io/images/sbsn7wuy/production/6036dad6b813a75085f5b3c085ddf6a9ce319776-665x436.jpg\",\"width\":665,\"orientation\":\"landscape\"}},\"mediaAspectRatio\":\"16:9\",\"tag\":{\"name\":\"Press\",\"slug\":\"press\"},\"introduction\":\"The future of global branding isn’t being shaped in London or New York. In this sharp take, Koto’s APAC MD Damian Borchok breaks down why the real creative edge now sits in Asia and what that means for brand leaders today. If you’re still applying Western playbooks, you’re already behind.\",\"image\":{\"alt\":\"\",\"height\":0,\"url\":\"\",\"width\":0,\"orientation\":\"landscape\"},\"body\":[{\"_key\":\"c01a28dd6de3\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"bc4e7808b300\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"APAC isn’t the edge of branding. It’s where a lot of the next moves are happening. Borchok lays out a simple point: the old model of Western-led global branding is losing relevance. Large networks expanded across Asia, but too often delivered average work at premium prices. As they pull back, space opens for independent studios and local players who bring stronger craft and a deeper understanding of culture. \"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"452bf01f2862\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"bc4e7808b300\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"This isn’t just a regional story. APAC represents 60% of the world’s population and will dominate global growth over the next decade. But scale isn’t the interesting part, the shift is in ambition. The most exciting companies in the region aren’t trying to catch up to Western brands. They are building their own categories, with their own references, often rooted in local culture rather than global sameness. \"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"02c0ceeaac69\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"bc4e7808b300\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"What this means in practice: repeating what worked in the past won’t get you far. Strong brands come from a clear point of view, not recycled playbooks. For agencies and in-house teams, the job is to build with the region, not apply a template to it. launching CcType, a new type foundry shaped by years of building brands that have to work everywhere, from websites and apps to campaigns, motion, and billboards. The launch reflects a simple observation: many typefaces work well in one place but struggle when brands need them to perform across every touchpoint. \\n\\nRather than releasing a large library of fonts, CcType begins with a single typeface, CcTimeline. Designed for branding, it gives designers the flexibility to move between bold campaign moments, digital products, and everyday brand communications without losing a consistent look and feel. Adjustable features let teams change its character while keeping the system cohesive. \\n\\nThe launch also introduces a simpler way to buy fonts. A one-time licence based on company size covers brand, web, and app use, with no subscriptions, renewal fees, traffic limits, or extra web licensing
